_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "change_seq" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "template_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "answers_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lon" REAL NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "altitude_m" REAL NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_data_json" TEXT NULL, "assignment_id" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "progress_pct" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_ops" ("op_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "error_fields_json" TEXT NULL, "server_row_json" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("op_uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachment_queue" ("sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'image/jpeg', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sha256"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursor" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "form_template_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "definition_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "change_seq" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NULL, "change_seq" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "change_seq" INTEGER NULL, "template_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "assigned_to" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_for" INTEGER NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lon" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "wbs" TEXT NOT NULL, "outline_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_validated_pct" REAL NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_task_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "qr_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_catalog_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meter_reading_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meter_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meter_unit" TEXT NULL, "meter_value" REAL NULL, "items_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fuel_catalog_cache" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fuel_fill_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "station_id" TEXT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "fuel_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'acpm', "voucher_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "filled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gallons" REAL NOT NULL, "meter_unit" TEXT NULL, "meter_value" REAL NULL, "work_front" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "driver_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "driver_document" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transport_catalog_cache" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_id" TEXT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "material_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume_m3" REAL NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "dispatched_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "driver_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "driver_document" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "usage_report_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "usage_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activity" TEXT NOT NULL, "location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "start_meter" REAL NULL, "end_meter" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
